author: 1337isnot1337, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: For the unchanged h=1 operator identity of Anthropic's Appendix B, deleting oscillator indices while retaining index 1 yields an exact defect m Id at the first missing index m. This rules out the proposed sparse-index extension under its stated unchanged coefficients. Restricted partition growth and arithmetic energy rescaling are recorded separately; no larger SAT alpha is obtained.

A positive improvement requires a different two-order operator identity and dual label pairing, or compression of the actual unthinned pieces
